title: Validate save destinations before waiting or writing
objective: Make ProjectStore.SaveAsync reject blank or non-.msculpt2 destination paths before acquiring the save gate or mutating directories, while preserving case-insensitive .msculpt2 acceptance and existing load/migration behavior. Existing ProjectStore.ProjectExtension is ".msculpt2"; reuse it with StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase. Preserve the existing null-state check. Invalid-path checks must run even when the provided cancellation token is already cancelled.
